description: This file contains utility functions for testing RSA signatures and key generation, including parsing RSA keys from files, generating RSA keys, signing data, and encoding messages for testing RSA blind signatures. It also includes predefined test vectors for RSA blind signature schemes, particularly for testing against IETF standards.

methods.name: ReadFileToString
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file into a string, returning an error if the file cannot be opened.

methods.name: ParseRsaKeysFromFile
methods.description: Parses RSA public and private keys from a binary proto file.

methods.name: GenerateRSAKey
methods.description: Generates an RSA key pair with specified modulus size and public exponent.

methods.name: PopulateTestVectorKeys
methods.description: Populates RSA public and private key structures from given components, including CRT parameters.

methods.name: CreateTestKey
methods.description: Creates an RSA key and associated public key parameters for testing, with specified key size and signature parameters.

methods.name: TestSign
methods.description: Signs blinded data using RSA private key, producing a raw RSA signature.

methods.name: TestSignWithPublicMetadata
methods.description: Signs blinded data with public metadata, computing a private exponent based on the metadata.

methods.name: EncodeMessageForTests
methods.description: Encodes a message for testing RSA signatures with PSS padding.

methods.name: GetStandardRsaKeyPair
methods.description: Generates a standard RSA key pair of specified size.

methods.name: GetStrongRsaKeys2048
methods.description: Loads a predefined 2048-bit RSA key pair from a test data file.

methods.name: GetAnotherStrongRsaKeys2048
methods.description: Loads an alternative 2048-bit RSA key pair from a test data file.

methods.name: GetStrongRsaKeys3072
methods.description: Loads a 3072-bit RSA key pair from a test data file.

methods.name: GetStrongRsaKeys4096
methods.description: Loads a 4096-bit RSA key pair from a test data file.

methods.name: GetIetfStandardRsaBlindSignatureTestVector
methods.description: Provides predefined test vectors for RSA blind signatures according to IETF standards.

methods.name: GetIetfStandardRsaBlindSignatureTestKeys
methods.description: Returns RSA key pair for IETF standard RSA blind signature test vector.

methods.name: GetIetfRsaBlindSignatureWithPublicMetadataTestVectors
methods.description: Provides test vectors for RSA blind signatures with public metadata.

methods.name: GetIetfRsaBlindSignatureWithPublicMetadataTestKeys
methods.description: Returns RSA key pair for RSA blind signature with public metadata test vectors.

methods.name: RandomString
methods.description: Generates a random string of specified length using provided RNG.
